name: 蒸汽波
description: 柔亮粉紫与薄荷青渐变融入低清颗粒，气氛慵懒、迷幻而复古。
rendering_prompt: Use pinkish purple, mint cyan, and pale blue for a softly luminous retro-digital palette, with slightly faded colors, loose gradients, and subtle electronic distortion. Selected surfaces may show cool chrome highlights or smooth plastic reflections, with moderately simplified detail. Blend fine low-resolution electronic grain with dreamlike detachment. Keep the rhythm languid, psychedelic, and nostalgic, unifying color and light without piling on decoration.
avoid: 高对比速度线、装饰符号堆砌、抢眼文字
difference: 蒸汽波柔淡慵懒；合成波深色高反差；Y2K 明亮而强调材料
tuning: 压低反差与锐度，用一组柔亮渐变统一主体和背景。
